decisions.reason: Defines paste_image/paste_file names with (2),(3) numbering before the extension until free, scopes renaming to the clipboard acquisition path before record creation in add(), and explicitly keeps drop/picker names unchanged; batch/live reservations are covered under the conflict-source design.

Identifies live composer snapshot occurrences as the authoritative occupied-name source, explains the records subscription deletes entries on any momentary empty snapshot while the chip remains live, and unions records only as an accelerator for in-flight entries, not as the source of truth.

Grounds the root cause in the captured response (x-cache HIT, age 178, page only up to v0.2.9) and renderCurrentChip showing the fetched tag; prescribes semantic comparison against running PLUGIN_VERSION, showing update only when remote is strictly newer and otherwise the newer/running version, never an older fetched tag.

Proposes repeated same-name pastes asserting distinct coexistence of paste_image.png/(2)/(3), drop and picker paths keeping real names, name reuse after chip deletion (live conflict state), and chip tests with stale-older and strictly-newer stubbed tags against the running version.

Requires bumping package.json and hand-inlined PLUGIN_VERSION together with a node --check syntax check, and explains users receive the update by hard refresh of the served artifact since there is no host-side update endpoint; a tag or chip alone does not install anything.
